# Beril

> Cybersecurity intelligence and assessment skill. Reads public research with Camoufox, scans local artifacts, and keeps evidence-linked catalogs.

Agents should start with `AGENTS.md`, then `SKILL.md`, then the router.

## Core

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): generic agent entry point
- [OPENAI.md](OPENAI.md): OpenAI alias
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): operating loop and quality gates
- [agents/router.md](agents/router.md): intake and routing
- [README.md](README.md): install and project map
- [docs/break-my-app.md](docs/break-my-app.md): request-to-report runbook
- [docs/agents.md](docs/agents.md): agent file matrix

## Assessment

- [references/techniques.md](references/techniques.md): 25 method cards
- [references/reverse-engineering.md](references/reverse-engineering.md): Ghidra, Binary Ninja, IDA, debuggers
- [references/vulnerability-research.md](references/vulnerability-research.md): bug classes and triage
- [references/fuzzing.md](references/fuzzing.md): harnesses and campaigns
- [references/exploit-development.md](references/exploit-development.md): ROP, heap, UAF
- [references/mobile-reverse.md](references/mobile-reverse.md): Android and iOS
- [references/firmware-iot.md](references/firmware-iot.md): extraction and emulation

## Training

- [references/curriculum.md](references/curriculum.md): 25 weeks
- [references/exercises.md](references/exercises.md): 68 drills
- [references/self-training.md](references/self-training.md): reflection loop
- [labs/README.md](labs/README.md): local labs

## Commands

```bash
./beril scan --target <url-or-path>
./beril scan --target <binary> --deep
./beril labs --run
./beril train --status
```

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): concatenated core docs
- [references/source-catalog.md](references/source-catalog.md): provenance
